subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: When reconnect, wait, and cache-only replay still cannot establish the accepted run’s terminal outcome, should `openclaw agent` preserve automatic isolated embedded fallback or fail closed unless the user explicitly opts in to rerun?
rationale: Both choices are defensible but have different compatibility, cost, delivery, and stdout consequences; the open canonical discussion explicitly asks for this owner decision.

options.title: Approve one explicit exhaustion policy
options.body: Recommended: select automatic isolated fallback or fail-closed opt-in rerun, then require the branch’s implementation, CLI docs, and final-head proof to match that single contract.

options.title: Preserve automatic isolated fallback
options.body: Maintain existing CLI completion expectations while accepting that a rare unrecoverable disconnect can still execute a second isolated turn.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed recovery
options.body: Prevent an unproven second execution by default, with a clearly documented explicit rerun path for users who accept duplicate-side-effect risk.

recommendation.title: Approve one explicit exhaustion policy
recommendation.body: Recommended: select automatic isolated fallback or fail-closed opt-in rerun, then require the branch’s implementation, CLI docs, and final-head proof to match that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision directly changes the fallback containment behavior introduced by the merged recovery-safety work.
